note: Phase 1 baseline (2026-10-27). Hand-traced from the code by the person scoring, before reading any journey the tracer wrote. Components are the boxes `pathlight setup --yes` draws for this repo (app, server, shared, plugins). Two of the three answers cross the network (HTTP and a websocket), so their main hops have no import behind them and no relationship in the drafted model: a trace that only draws model-backed hops cannot match them. 'files' are the files a correct trace has to read.

questions.question: What happens when someone types in a document, from the keystroke in the editor to the change appearing for the other people editing it?
What happens when someone creates a new document from the sidebar, from the click to the document appearing in other people's sidebars?
What happens when someone signs in with Slack, from the button on the login page to arriving signed in?
